dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: I have orders from the Acting Grand Master to stand guard here and warn all citizens not to go up the mountain.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Just a while back, I had to stop a family of three who wanted to head up the mountain for a camping trip, and some children who were looking to have a snowball fight on the summit.

dialogues.speaker: Riese
dialogues.text: Well, I can't blame them for not being more aware — Mondstadt has been a little too peaceful lately, to the point where no one can imagine how bad conditions are on Dragonspine...
